knowledge_gaps: The baseline terminal loss, negative count, exclusions, reduction and branch coefficients are unspecified. Without these, the proposal may duplicate existing training or change several factors simultaneously.

Replacing the terminal objective while also introducing 32 negatives and complete-training-history exclusions confounds loss choice, candidate count and exclusion policy. Preserving branch coefficients does not preserve relative gradient contributions.

Complete-training-history exclusions use interactions occurring after a sampled terminal endpoint. This is not hidden-test leakage, but it introduces future training knowledge into candidate selection and requires an explicit justification and matched control.

The uniform-without-replacement sampler is not implemented. Reproduction requires its exact algorithm, dedicated RNG, handling of catalog shortages and measured runtime within the shared budget. The supplied helper alone is not an executable training integration.

Raw margin changes can reflect score scaling rather than better ranking. Terminal-specific fixed-panel ranking diagnostics, a prespecified baseline comparison and identical checkpoint opportunities are needed; sampled HR@10 cannot establish full-catalog gains.

Originality 3/10 is reasonable, but potential 7/10 is speculative and difficulty 3/10 understates unresolved sampler and integration work. No evidence currently favors this objective for stale-interest errors specifically.
